GPU Fusion - third-party components
===================================

Qt 6.8.3 (Qt Core, Qt Gui, Qt Widgets and the "windows" platform, "modernwindows" style and
image-format plugins)
  Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.
  Used under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3 (LGPLv3); the license texts are in
  licenses\lgpl-3.0.txt and licenses\gpl-3.0.txt (the LGPLv3 incorporates the GPLv3).
  GPU Fusion uses the unmodified Qt libraries as separate DLLs (Qt6*.dll and the DLLs in the
  platforms, styles and imageformats folders); you may replace them with compatible builds of your own.
  Qt source code: https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.8/6.8.3/single/
  More information: https://www.qt.io/licensing/open-source-lgpl-obligations

Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140*.dll, vcruntime140*.dll)
  Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation. Redistributed under the Visual Studio redistributable
  code terms ("Redist" files of the Visual C++ 2022 toolset).

Windows components used at run time, not distributed with GPU Fusion: DirectX (DXGI, Direct3D 11/12),
Media Foundation, D3DKMT, PDH, SetupAPI. NVIDIA NVML (nvml.dll) is loaded from the NVIDIA driver
installation when present; it is not distributed with GPU Fusion.
